cards.note: Fires on its own words rather than being expanded into twelve derivative cards: the verse asserts a transfer principle -- whatever was declared for the Ascendant sign also holds when the Moon occupies it -- without itself restating the twelve lists PD.09.Lagna.* already carry. Encoding it as those twelve cards re-quoted under a Moon condition would misattribute their own words ("If the Ascendant falls in Aries..." is not true of a chart where the Moon, not the lagna, is in Aries); this card instead states the transfer itself as its own claim, naming the sign the reader must cross-reference.
